⚡ HOW TO PLAY ⚡

Find the target words by tracing a straight line of letters.

📱
PHONE / TABLET:Swipe across letters, or tap the first and last letters.
🖱️
MOUSE / TRACKPAD:Drag across letters, or click the first and last letters.
⌨️
KEYBOARD:Use arrow keys to move, Enter or Space to select, and Escape to cancel.

COMPLETE PLAYER GUIDE

Master every hazard, multiplier, and hidden feature

🎯 1. Controls & Input

Drag across letters, Click-Click the start and end tiles, or use Arrow Keys + Enter/Space on a keyboard (press Esc to cancel).

⚡ 2. Combos, 2X Tiles & Hyper-Drive

  • Rapid Combos: Find words within 4.5 seconds of each other to boost your multiplier (+0.5x) and earn +50 bonus coins.
  • Glowing 2X Tiles: Swiping a word through a gold 2X tile doubles your active multiplier and awards +40 coins.
  • Hyper-Drive: Reach 16.0x and chain a word within 3 seconds for a massive +4.0x overdrive surge (up to 32.0x).
  • Overtime Frenzy: Run out of time with only 1 word left to trigger a 15-second clutch round with 2.0x rewards!

🌀 3. Board Hazards & Obstacles

  • Shift / Quake / Flood: When the Shift timer hits zero, unused letters scramble or cascade downward (deducting 0.2x combo).
  • Glitch Tiles (? / #): Appear in Daily & Extreme (Lvl 6+). They mask filler tiles—never target words—and clear when you solve an adjacent word.
  • Eclipse Ring (Lvl 11–20): Dims the outer ring of tiles until you find your first target word.

🐷 4. Secret Words, Vault & Unlocks

  • Piggy Bank (Unlocks Lvl 2): Swipe any valid English word not on your target list to bank +15 secret coins.
  • Explorer's Codex (Unlocks Lvl 3): Discover 50 special words across 5 volumes for permanent gameplay perks and equipable badges.
  • Trophy Cup (Unlocks Lvl 5): Compete in a 30-player weekly division for a 500-coin grand prize.

🔥 5. Win Streaks, Cryptic & Contracts

  • Win Streaks (1–5): Consecutive wins unlock automatic starting buffs (+15s time, Beacon Clue/Deflector, 2X tile, Auto-Freeze, and 1.5x score).
  • Cryptic Mode & Contracts: Toggle Cryptic before starting for +50% payouts, or take on Purist (no power-ups) and Speedrun (<45s) contracts for bonus coins.
